body: Two research tasks are pushed, both from holes R70 opened. C52 THE TOURNAMENT AND THE GRADE: six disciplines lost their championship object, so research the championship EVENT that replaces the belt, the amateur tournaments beneath it, and the GRADE (belt colours) those tournaments divide by; A4 asks whether a five-contest day can ride machinery that settles one bout per card, C1 keeps the two nouns sharing the word belt apart. C53 THE BELT NOBODY SANCTIONS: boxing is the starter discipline and all 12 of its world titles now carry an empty organization_id permanently; price four options and say what a sanctioning body actually DOES. Both are research only - two markdown files each, no .gd, no JSON, no tests, no HANDOFF. Task files research/TASK_C52.md and TASK_C53.md, each with its own START PROMPT. C50 and C51 still stand.
